title: Deposit of Amount Before Filing Appeal

content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer, wants to file an appeal against a decision of the State Commission. He needs to deposit 50% of the amount before filing the appeal with the National Commission.
content.outcome: Rahul must deposit 50% of the amount as per the rules of the National Commission before filing his appeal, along with the required documents such as the bill, cash memo, or receipt.

user_queries: What is the procedure for depositing the amount before filing an appeal?
How much amount needs to be deposited before filing an appeal?
What documents are required for depositing the amount?
